what: Phase 2 pro features: (1) Configurable hook intensity — users control auto-injection volume at SessionStart, blocking vs soft per hook type, which hooks are active. Config via aide-memory config or .aide/config.json. Default: all hooks active, blocking where designed. Pro users get fine-grained control. (2) Automatic memory cleanup — detect and surface stale/conflicting/duplicate memories. Could run as PostToolUse (after edits that invalidate stored context), post-session (batch cleanup), or periodic background task. Examples: memory says "auth uses bcrypt" but code now uses argon2, memory references deleted file, two memories contradict each other. Agent gets prompted: "3 memories may be stale — review and aide_forget or aide_update." Both are monetization features — free tier gets opinionated defaults, paid tier gets customization + maintenance.
why: User identified both as pro/Phase 2 features. Configurability for power users who want less aggressive prompting. Memory cleanup solves the inevitable staleness problem as codebases evolve — memories that were true when stored become wrong over time.
